camel_example: aliyun gwlb TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'gwlb-nrnrxwd15en27r0000' --Tag.1.Key testKey --Tag.1.Value testValue --ResourceType loadbalancer --method POST --force
description_en: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources
description_zh: 为指定的资源列表创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb tag-resources --resource-type loadbalancer --resource-id gwlb-nrnrxwd15en27r0000 --tag Value=testValue Key=testKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

loadbalancer: a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance.

listener: a listener.

servergroup: a server group
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：

loadbalancer：网关型负载均衡实例。
listener：监听。
servergroup：服务器组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs in each call
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID列表。一次调用最多支持添加 50 个资源 ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, the request format, and the service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a normal request. If the request passes the check, the system returns a 2xx HTTP status code and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加标签。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
